longDescription: A local-first React and TypeScript lyric-video editor focused on music, lyrics, typography, synchronization, layered composition, assets, phone editing, and deterministic export.
problemSolved: Give a creator one focused workspace for turning music and timed lyrics into a styled lyric video without needing a general-purpose video editor.
browserRequirements: Modern browser with the media codecs and features required by the selected export format
offlineSupport: Core editing and local transcription are local-first after required assets and models are available; online catalog features contact external providers.
networkRequirements: Initial local Whisper model download when not already cached
Online catalog searches, previews, and downloads contact their source providers
architecture: Local-first React/TypeScript editor. Timing uses integer milliseconds; playback uses the audio context clock; preview and export share the renderer. Audio analysis and transcription run in workers. Projects are stored locally and can be bundled for export.
buildInstructions: Use Node 22.13+ and the pnpm version in package.json. Run pnpm install, pnpm media:prepare, then pnpm dev:pages. Run pnpm test and pnpm typecheck for verification. pnpm build:pages creates the GitHub Pages build in dist-pages.

features.name: Project-based lyric video editing
features.description: Create a project, choose an aspect ratio, import audio, and edit a complete lyric-video composition.

features.name: Automatic and manual lyrics
features.description: Detect lyrics locally or import and paste TXT, LRC, SRT, VTT, ASS, or SSA, then edit lines and words.

features.name: Align existing lyrics
features.description: Match supplied lyrics against recognized words in whole-song or nearby-refinement modes without replacing the original text.
knownIssues: Prior user testing reported that automatic alignment was not accurate enough on the tested song.

features.name: Manual synchronization
features.description: Use playback, Set start & next, timeline controls, and numeric timing fields to synchronize lyric events.

features.name: Layered composition
features.description: Edit typography, positions, colors, motion, backgrounds, extra text, reactive layers, and keyframes.

features.name: Online asset and effect catalog
features.description: Browse supported Commons media, curated Google Fonts, editable text motions, and public custom JSON catalogs.

features.name: Local-first transcription
features.description: Run local Whisper in a worker; audio and project media are not uploaded by default.

features.name: Portrait phone workspace
features.description: Use compact playback, bottom navigation, a collapsible timeline, and phone-specific editor behavior.

features.name: Portable project archive
features.description: Save locally or export a .lyricforge archive containing project data and media.

features.name: Video, audio, and subtitle export
features.description: Export rendered video, audio, subtitles, or editable project output through the deterministic rendering and encoding pipeline.

screens.name: Editor Workspace
screens.description: Coordinates preview, playback, editing controls, and timeline workflows.
screens.responsiveBehavior: Phone layout uses compact playback, bottom navigation, and a collapsible timeline.

screens.name: Lyrics
screens.purpose: Create, import, edit, synchronize, and align lyric events.
screens.description: Contains Auto Detect, Paste, Import, manual sync, and Align existing lyrics workflows.
screens.responsiveBehavior: Phone exposes Align lyrics and lyric search in the compact lyric workspace.

screens.name: Preview
screens.purpose: View the rendered composition and timeline.
screens.description: Uses the same rendering path that feeds export.
screens.responsiveBehavior: Phone Preview gives the canvas and timeline maximum space.

screens.name: Online Catalog
screens.purpose: Browse and import media, fonts, and motion resources.
screens.description: Searches supported public providers and retains source, creator, and license details with imported assets.
screens.responsiveBehavior: Available from More on a phone.

systems.name: Project schema and timing
systems.purpose: Store project and timing primitives and brand settings.
systems.currentImplementation: Implemented; timing is stored in integer milliseconds.

systems.name: Editor state and undo history
systems.purpose: Maintain editor state and immutable undo history.

systems.name: Audio engine
systems.purpose: Schedule playback, build offline mixes, and analyze waveform, beat, and FFT data.

systems.name: Lyric alignment
systems.purpose: Match existing text to recognized words and require review before applying changes.
systems.currentImplementation: Implemented; prior user feedback still records accuracy limitations.
limitations: Accuracy must be validated on real songs before treating alignment as resolved.

systems.name: Transcription
systems.purpose: Provide local/default transcription and an optional custom endpoint.

systems.name: Renderer and animation
systems.purpose: Share preview and export rendering and manage media decoding.

systems.name: Catalog and asset pipeline
systems.purpose: Manage imported media and fonts plus online provider catalogs.

systems.name: Local project persistence
systems.purpose: Store projects locally and support portable .lyricforge archives.

systems.name: Export pipeline
systems.purpose: Encode finished output through the deterministic renderer and available browser encoders.
systems.currentImplementation: Implemented with native H.264 when available and local FFmpeg WebAssembly fallback otherwise.

testingNotes: Automatic lyric alignment was previously user-tested and reported as not accurate enough.
The current repository documents pnpm test for timing, history, catalog, and project regressions plus pnpm typecheck for application types.

repositoryInfo.localRunInstructions: pnpm install && pnpm media:prepare && pnpm dev:pages

runtime.notes: Public GitHub Pages deployment was verified reachable before adding it to Catelog.

canonicalInstructions: Treat this Catelog record as the current source of truth.
importantContext: The maintained unpacked source lives at the repository root; LyricForge-v3-source.zip is retained as reference.
The repository documentation describes a local-first editor with local Whisper transcription and deterministic export.
doNotAssume: Do not assume the alignment accuracy issue is fully resolved without testing against the user's real songs.
Do not replace original lyric text while aligning existing lyrics unless explicitly requested.
preferredNextActions: Record export limitations and supported formats
